newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close up on return of buyers.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close up on return of buyers.

text.p: Dhaka stocks ended a three-session bear-run to close higher on Tuesday as blue chips brought back buyers, brokers said.
The benchmark index of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) edged up 4.25 points or 0.40 percent at 1.048.33 on a higher turnover of 48.6 million taka. Gainers led losers by 71 to 46.
Brokers said many good scrips had become lucrative after losing for several sessions, helping a recovery of the market.
Apex Foods gained 5.43 taka to 290.43 and Bata Shoe Co rose 0.04 to 124.46.
